text: Who is Vishnu? Ask, and you may be given ten answers.
asr: Who is Vishnu? Ask and you may be given 10 answers.

text: He is the preserver of the world, the keeper of its balance, often painted blue: the colour of the sky and the sea.
asr: He is the preserver of the world. The keeper of its balance often painted blue. The color of the sky and the sea.

text: And whenever that balance fails, he comes down into the world, each time in a new form. These are his avatars.
First, a fish. In a great flood, Matsya towed the boat of Manu, the first man, to safety.
asr: First a fish. In a great flood, Matzia towed the boat of Manu, the first man to safety.

text: A tortoise. Kurma held a mountain on his back, while the ocean was churned.
asr: A tortoise. Karma held a mountain on his back while the ocean was churned.

text: A boar. Varaha dived to the bottom of the sea, and lifted the drowned earth on his tusks.
asr: A bore. Viraha dived to the bottom of the sea and lifted the drowned earth on his tusks.

text: A man-lion. A demon king could not be killed by man or beast, by day or by night, inside or out. So Narasimha came at dusk, on a doorstep.
asr: A man lying. A demon king could not be killed by man or beast, by day or by night, inside or out. So Narasimha came at dusk on a doorstep.

text: A dwarf. Vamana asked for three steps of land, and covered the universe in two.
asr: A dwarf. Vaimana asked for three steps of land and covered the universe in two.

text: A warrior with an axe: Parashurama.
asr: A warrior with an axe. Perishurama.

text: A prince with a bow: Rama, hero of the Ramayana.
A cowherd with a flute: Krishna, who taught the Bhagavad Gita.
asr: a cow heard with a flute. Krishna, who taught the Bhagavad Gita.

text: A teacher of peace. In many lists, the Buddha. In some others, Balarama.
And one still to come: Kalki, on a white horse, at the end of this age.
Some readers see a pattern in them: from the water, to the shore, to the land; from animal, to human, to sage.
So who is Vishnu? Perhaps the answer is in the word itself. Avatar means a descent. He is the one who keeps coming down to help.
